summary: Come for a fun cruise through Heartlake City in LEGO® Friends: Heartlake Rush!
description:
Race through Heartlake City with the LEGO® Friends and their pets! Play as Aliya, Autumn, Nova, Leo, Liann, and more. Customize rides, collect treasures, and dodge obstacles! 

Collect and customize with the LEGO® Friends in Heartlake City! Drive through the colorful streets with your favorite characters and their adorable pets.  

• Dodge traffic, roadblocks, and surprises on thrilling missions!  
• Collect coins, ice cream, fruit, flowers, gifts, and more cute surprises!  
• Customize your cars with cool colors, decals, tires, toppers, and trails!  
• Complete exciting missions to unlock amazing rewards and level up!  
• Earn daily rewards to keep the fun going!  
• Transform your car into a jet with Zobo the robot!  
• Unlock new LEGO® Friends characters, each with their unique pet!  
• Mix and match characters and custom cars for endless fun!  

Race, explore, and discover a world full of adventure with LEGO® Friends!  

FEATURES

• Safe and age-appropriate 

• Designed responsibly to let your child enjoy screen time while developing healthy digital habits at a young age 

• FTC Approved COPPA Safe Harbor Certification by Privo. 

• Play pre-downloaded content offline without wifi or internet 

• Regular updates with new content 

• Apple Family Sharing for easy subscription sharing with other family members 

• No third-party advertising 

IN-APP PURCHASES

 

This app contains sample content that is free to play. However, LOTS MORE fun and entertaining games and activities are available. You can buy individual units of content via in-app purchases.

 

Google Play does not permit in-app purchases and free apps to be shared via Family Library. Therefore, any purchases you make in this app will NOT be shareable via Family Library.
